title: Curtis Mason on Goodreads: 'Best book that I have read this year!'
summary: Goodreads reviewer who is currently advising three startup teams — one likely-to-sell, one IPO-track, one purpose-driven — recommends Incorruptible to all three regardless of exit path. He bought the audiobook, eBook, and plans to buy paper copies for his teams.
blockquote:
I have recommended this book to all 3 teams regardless. There are fantastic principles of governance to be found here.

Best book that I have read this year!
